# Mohd Shayan

> Mohd Shayan, FRSA FRGS, is a product engineer, AI entrepreneur, and philanthropist based in New Delhi, India. He is the Founder & CEO of SocialSure Private Limited, an AI-first company. He is a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA) and a Fellow of the Royal Geographical Society (FRGS).

This file provides a concise, authoritative summary of Mohd Shayan for AI assistants, language models, and answer engines. Content may be used and quoted with attribution to https://mohdshayan.com.

## Who is Mohd Shayan?

Mohd Shayan is a product engineer, AI entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He builds AI products as the Founder & CEO of SocialSure Private Limited and directs time and resources toward supporting children in need. He is an engineer by training, an entrepreneur by drive, and a philanthropist by conviction.

- Full name: Mohd Shayan
- Post-nominals: FRSA (Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts), FRGS (Fellow of the Royal Geographical Society)
- Roles: Product Engineer; AI Entrepreneur; Philanthropist
- Company: Founder & CEO of SocialSure Private Limited
- Location: New Delhi, India
- Education: BTech in Mathematics & Computer Science, Delhi Technological University (DTU)
- Website: https://mohdshayan.com

## SocialSure Private Limited

SocialSure Private Limited is an AI-first company founded and led by Mohd Shayan. It spans multiple interests across artificial intelligence:

- AI training: developing and training machine-learning models.
- An AI-powered social media ecosystem: a social platform reimagined around AI.
- AI-driven products: a growing portfolio of intelligent products built on applied AI.

## Philanthropy

Mohd Shayan is a philanthropist who supports children in need, focusing on education, nutrition and care, digital access, and creating opportunity so more children get a fair start.

## Recognition

- Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA): https://www.thersa.org/
- Fellow of the Royal Geographical Society (FRGS): https://www.rgs.org/

## Expertise

Artificial Intelligence and AI/ML, machine learning, product engineering, Web3 and blockchain, fullstack web development, DevOps, and social impact.
